feeds.title: PhillyVoice
feeds.description: PhillyVoice is a digital media publisher and marketing company that produces engaging content for the Philadelphia region and beyond. Looking beyond simple headlines, the newsroom strives to tell stories that inform, inspire and drive conversation. It is your source for Philadelphia and South Jersey's breaking news, sports, entertainment, health, business, things to do, events, culture, and more.

feeds.title: NBC10 Philadelphia
feeds.description: NBC10 Philadelphia is the go-to place for exclusive local stories, the latest breaking news, weather updates, and more. Get the latest Philadelphia news, weather, traffic, entertainment, and health. NBC Philadelphia is owned by NBC Universal media and mainly focuses on covering Philadelphia city.

feeds.title: 6abc Action News
feeds.description: Action News is Philadelphia's source for breaking news, weather, and video, covering Philadelphia. For more than 70 years WPVI-TV/6abc has been broadcasting programs to viewers in the Delaware Valley. Get the latest Philadelphia area news, traffic, weather, politics, and sports from 6abc.

feeds.title: Chalkbeat Philadelphia
feeds.description: Chalkbeat Philadelphia focuses on essential education reporting, covering topics such as school funding, policy changes, and community stories. The site features in-depth articles, updates on local school districts, opinion pieces, and multimedia content. It aims to provide valuable information for families, educators, and stakeholders in the Philadelphia education system.

feeds.title: Philadelphia Magazine
feeds.description: News and politics from Philadelphia magazine. A look at the people who influence the city and what's happening in Philadelphia today. It provides topical, in-depth reports on crucial and controversial issues confronting the region-business trends, political analysis, metropolitan planning, sociological trends, plus critical reviews of the cultural, sports and entertainment scene.

feeds.title: WHYY

feeds.title: PHL17
